notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE
notes.content:
A content update has been released this update contains

+ Turtle enemy
+ Enchanced upgrades (maded trees more viable)
+ 2 New achievements
+ Now the planet shows how leveled up it is



* Fixed bugs related with saws and slashes that maded the game crash


Tomorrow at 10:30 PDT Planetbound will be 50% off!!!

Have a nice following interval of time
